svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 100 mm of 40 x 3 mm flat bar; round the corners 3 mm, deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On the centre line: bolt hole 5.5 mm, 15 mm from one end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: antenna stud hole 60 mm from the same end, sized to the antenna's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stud (16.5 mm for an M16 stud; check its datasheet).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bracket lies flat across the top of the outer tube, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolt hole over the tube; one M5 x 30 bolt through bracket and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube, nyloc nut under the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The antenna sits on top, its stud through the large hole, nut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: underneath; the antenna is 45 mm off the bar's centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the antenna sits flat and the bracket cannot turn when

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bolt is tight (bracket edge against your thumb).
